target.split_separation: 3 is not a norm from Q(i); modulo 3, x^2+y^2=3z^2 forces x,y,z divisible by 3 after clearing denominators.
very_general_conditions_used: A is chosen outside rational decomposition/isogeny Hodge loci, hence is simple at the strength used here

items.claim: dim_Q W_K(A)=2 and W_K consists of (3,3)-classes
items.verification: V=H^1(A,Q) has dim_K 6; wedge_K^6 V is one-dimensional over K and therefore two-dimensional over Q. Weil signature (3,3) makes the two complex determinant lines type (3,3).

items.claim: divisor cube is separated from W_K
items.verification: Over C, V=V_sigma+V_sigma_bar and H^6 decomposes as direct sum B_a=wedge^a V_sigma tensor wedge^(6-a) V_sigma_bar. W_K,C=B_6+B_0. A K-compatible divisor theta lies in the mixed (1,1) exterior-count block, hence theta^3 lies in B_3 and has zero B_0/B_6 projection.

items.claim: split source transport cannot be silently imported
items.verification: The target Hermitian determinant class [-3] differs from the split class [-1] by [3], and 3 is not a Gaussian norm. This independently preserves the H0M discriminant wall at the exact scope used.

exceptional_projection_typing.complex_decomposition: H^6(A,C)=direct_sum_{a=0}^6 B_a, B_a=wedge^a V_sigma tensor wedge^(6-a) V_sigma_bar
exceptional_projection_typing.projection_test: proj_W is equivalently the B_6+B_0 exterior-count projection; every B_3 class has proj_W=0

family_no_go_theorem.name: H0N_NATURAL_SOURCE_FAMILY_ZERO_EXCEPTIONAL_PROJECTION
family_no_go_theorem.statement: On the declared very-general non-split target A, every codimension-three class produced by families F1-F5 below lies in Q*theta^3 (or is zero) and therefore has zero exceptional W_K projection.

families.name: SEMIHOMOGENEOUS_EXTENSION_SHIFT_ENVELOPE
families.definition: Finite direct sums, extensions, and shifts generated by simple semihomogeneous vector bundles on A.
families.formula: For simple semihomogeneous E of rank r>0, Mukai gives ch(E)=r*exp(c1(E)/r), so ch_3(E)=c1(E)^3/(6*r^2). Since NS(A)_Q=Q*theta, ch_3(E) is a rational multiple of theta^3. Chern character is additive under direct sums/extensions and changes sign under odd shifts.
families.conclusion: proj_W(ch_3)=0 for every object in the declared envelope.

families.name: TARGET_SIDE_FOURIER_MUKAI_ORBIT_OF_LINE_OR_SEMIHOMOGENEOUS_OBJECTS
families.definition: Fourier-Mukai autoequivalences of D^b(A) applied to line bundles or simple semihomogeneous sheaves/objects on A; no transport from the split component is used.
families.formula: Orlov/Mukai semihomogeneous stabilizer theory makes the A x Ahat stabilizer dimension invariant under the symplectic action associated to an autoequivalence, so semihomogeneous objects remain semihomogeneous. Full-support outputs reduce to F1. Finite-support outputs have ch_3=0 on a sixfold.
families.conclusion: No target-side Fourier-Mukai orbit starting from these sources produces a nonzero exceptional ch_3 component.

families.name: POLARIZATION_AND_K_ENDOMORPHISM_TAUTOLOGICAL_BUNDLE_ALGEBRA
families.definition: The cohomological/K-theoretic source algebra generated from line/semihomogeneous sources by tensor, dual, finite sums/cones, and pullback/pushforward along nonzero target-side K-endomorphism isogenies.
families.formula: NS(A)_Q=Q*theta implies f^*theta=lambda_f*theta. Hence f^*(theta^3)=lambda_f^3*theta^3. For an isogeny, f_*f^*=deg(f), so f_* also preserves Q*theta^3. Tensor/dual/additivity preserve the divisor polynomial algebra.
families.conclusion: Every codimension-three characteristic class remains in Q*theta^3.

families.name: TAUTOLOGICAL_DEGENERACY_DETERMINANTAL_CYCLES
families.definition: Expected-codimension degeneracy/determinantal loci whose source and target bundles/complexes have rational Chern classes in Q[theta], in particular those built from F1-F3.
families.formula: Thom-Porteous/Schur formulas are universal polynomials in Chern classes. In codimension three the possible Chern monomials are c1^3, c1*c2, c3; each is a multiple of theta^3 when every c_i lies in Q*theta^i.
families.conclusion: The codimension-three cycle class has zero exceptional projection. Arbitrary degeneracy data with a primitive c3 input is deliberately outside this theorem.

families.name: K_TAUTOLOGICAL_CORRESPONDENCE_OPERATORS
families.definition: Correspondence operators generated cohomologically by graphs of target-side K-endomorphism isogenies, their pull/push operations, and cup products by divisor classes.
families.formula: These generators preserve the divisor algebra Q[theta]; in degree six they preserve its one-dimensional component Q*theta^3.
families.conclusion: Starting from divisor/semihomogeneous seeds, such correspondences cannot create W_K. A genuinely new non-tautological algebraic correspondence is not excluded.

counterexample_search.observation: Markman's secant-sheaf mechanism produces algebraic Weil classes on split/discriminant -1 sixfolds.
counterexample_search.effect: Confirms the theorem must not be universal over all sheaves/correspondences; the target discriminant and family hypotheses are essential.

counterexample_search.observation: Koike's Prym dominance gives algebraicity for Gaussian sixfolds at the classical discriminant-1/trivial control.
counterexample_search.effect: Confirms that a non-tautological geometric correspondence/cycle can escape the semihomogeneous divisor algebra on a different component; it does not touch the [-3] target.

counterexample_search.observation: A Fourier-Mukai transform may exchange degree-zero line-type objects with finite-support sheaves.
counterexample_search.effect: On a sixfold a finite-support sheaf has no ch_3 contribution, so this is consistent rather than a counterexample.

counterexample_search.observation: A vector bundle/complex with an already nonzero W_K component in ch_3 would trivially evade F1-F4.
counterexample_search.effect: This is exactly the missing seed object, not something the no-go is allowed to assume away.

counterexample_search.observation: A new algebraic correspondence whose cohomological operator is not generated by divisor/K-endomorphism operations could in principle hit W_K.
counterexample_search.effect: Remains an explicit open route and unblock condition.

terminal.missing_object: A target-side non-semihomogeneous algebraic/derived object E with proj_W(ch_3(E)) != 0, or a genuinely non-tautological algebraic correspondence with nonzero W_K image.
terminal.unblock_condition: Exhibit such an object/correspondence with exact cohomological calculation; semiregularity may only be instantiated after that seed exists.
terminal.forbidden_inference: Failure of F1-F5 does not imply W_K is non-algebraic and does not prove or disprove the Hodge conjecture.
